riskAssessment.reason: The change adds bounded public-source body retrieval and one-hop traversal. It must preserve independent partial failures, prevent entry pages from becoming evidence, avoid duplicate metrics, and keep the existing fail-closed judgment behavior.
riskAssessment.reviewedBy: User authorized the bounded SEC/IR discovery work and iterative local problem resolution on 2026-08-25.

reasons: The Work Item changes source acquisition and evidence observation boundaries and requires focused regression coverage plus full local quality checks.

executionDecision.reason: The user explicitly approved implementation. The scope, acceptance, scenarios, and local verification are bounded; hosted lifecycle actions are explicitly out of scope.

preReviewWarnings: SEC filing bodies must be fetched only from validated bounded submissions metadata, with finite response limits and independent failure status.
IR traversal must remain same-origin, one-hop, deduplicated, and globally capped; entry/index pages remain leads unless their body passes the existing claim gate.
SEC and IR observations must enter the shared candidate-to-evidence loop exactly once; no duplicate pending or unavailable metrics.
No source failure may be converted into a negative claim, guessed date, or ranking signal.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: SEC filing candidates obtain bounded document bodies from validated submissions metadata and retain accession, form, filing date, report date, primary document, and source URI provenance.
SEC filing body status is explicit as known, unknown, or unavailable, and a single document failure does not discard Company Facts or other filing candidates.
SEC document requests use a finite response-body limit, the existing SEC User-Agent, and no credentials or response body in failure messages.
Official IR discovery follows at most one same-origin nested hop under a finite global cap, deduplicates canonical URLs, excludes cross-origin links, and preserves bounded behavior.
Homepage, index, and entry observations remain leads and do not become validated evidence without a body-level claim satisfying the existing extraction gate.
SEC and IR document observations use the shared runtime promotion path without double-counting document candidates, pending leads, or unavailable sources.
The existing Stage and Ranking inputs are unchanged by the new acquisition path, and a fixture with no structural proof still emits no machine Ranking.
Company Facts remains available when only a filing-document request fails, existing non-SEC source behavior remains unchanged, and localized reports keep identical metric values.
TDD fixtures cover success, partial failure, finite-body safety, nested IR discovery, deduplication, cross-origin exclusion, cap enforcement, and no index promotion.
Operations documentation explains source availability, document leads, evidence candidates, validated evidence, and degraded-data interpretation.
Local format, lint, tests, AI Cockpit checks, checkpoints, and a deterministic dry-run pass with no unresolved discovered problem; hosted CI/PR/merge/closure are not required.
guidelines: New public APIs must be documented.
Do not import internal modules from other features.
Keep provider-specific parsing and failure semantics in the provider adapter; use the existing source-observation boundary for runtime integration.
Use deterministic bounded fixtures; do not depend on live external HTTP in tests.
Represent unavailable or pending material explicitly rather than silently dropping it or inferring a negative claim.
Preserve existing judgment and legacy behavior unless a test demonstrates the scoped acquisition defect.

intent.problem: The current Weekly Radar pipeline treats SEC submissions mostly as metadata and only discovers one level of official IR links. As a result, homepage availability and filing metadata can become pending material without discovering the actual document body needed for claim-level evidence, while SEC coverage can be entirely unavailable.
constraints: Keep source availability, document leads, EvidenceCandidate, and ValidatedEvidence distinct.
Keep retrieval bounded and fail-closed: same-origin only for IR, finite SEC body limits, independent partial failures, no guesses, and no live-network tests.
Do not modify Stage, Ranking, Top5, persistence, delivery, or external production state.
intent.rationale: The highest-value scoped repair is to make the existing SEC and IR adapters discover bounded document content and feed it into the already-governed shared evidence path. This improves acquisition quality without weakening the judgment gate or creating a second promotion pipeline.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A recent SEC filing body is available from validated submissions metadata.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The bounded filing document becomes a document observation with provenance and a body eligible for the existing claim gate.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add a failing fixture asserting one bounded filing request and body metadata, then implement and run the focused SEC tests.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: One SEC filing request fails while submissions, Company Facts, or other candidates remain usable.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The failed document is explicitly unavailable, independent facts and other observations remain, and no negative claim is emitted.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Use a deterministic HTTP fixture with one failed filing body and assert independent status, facts, and metrics.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: An official IR document links to a same-origin document one level deeper.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The nested document is discovered under the finite global cap, canonical duplicates collapse, and cross-origin links are excluded.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add nested, duplicate, cross-origin, and cap fixtures; observe RED before implementing the one-hop traversal and GREEN afterward.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Homepage or index content has no body-level production-system claim.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The page remains a source observation or pending lead and is not promoted to validated evidence.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run existing and new title/index-only fixtures through the common candidate extraction and validation path.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: The new observations enter the existing runtime without changing judgment semantics.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Evidence and source-availability metrics are distinct and counted once; Stage and Ranking remain fail-closed when structural proof is insufficient.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add integration assertions for observation conversion and metric counts, then run the full local quality and dry-run checks.
